lyrics:
[intro]
[verse]
The moonlight hits the dusty floor
There’s a shadow knocking at the door
No heartbeat drumming in the chest
But he’s better than all of the rest
[chorus]
Oh, he’s a dancing skeleton tonight
Shaking off the blues in the pale moonlight
Rattle and roll, let the spirit be free
It’s a dancing skeleton, wild and carefree
[verse]
No skin to hide a nervous grin
He’s letting all the rhythm in
The joints are creaking to the beat
He’s got the fire beneath his feet
[chorus]
Oh, he’s a dancing skeleton tonight
Shaking off the blues in the pale moonlight
Rattle and roll, let the spirit be free
It’s a dancing skeleton, wild and carefree
[bridge]
Click-clack, the midnight track
There’s no turning back
From the hollow frame in the dark
Lighting up a ghostly spark
[chorus]
Oh, he’s a dancing skeleton tonight
Shaking off the blues in the pale moonlight
Rattle and roll, let the spirit be free
It’s a dancing skeleton, wild and carefree
[outro]
